title: Union-merged ledgers do not order research items, so a sprint's research runs in parallel
goal: held --overlaps and check's unordered-overlap warning treat a root's union-merged ledgers (_sources.csv, _answers.md, _gaps.md, _conflicts.md, _anchors.csv, _fetch_state.csv) as shared, the way they treat a kb/_self doc, so research items that share only those files are not forced to run one after another; SP-5dffnlxn's eleven research items ran serially for about four hours because of them.
